name: MARKSMAN VR
detailed_description:
Precision. Patience. Perfection.
Become the ultimate precision marksman in MARKSMAN VR, a thrilling and immersive virtual reality sniper experience that tests your aim, strategy and nerves of steel. Designed for those who live for precision and crave the rush of pulling off the perfect shot, MARKSMAN VR will challenge you to prove your skills in a series of intense missions.

Your Mission

  • Stealth and Strategy: Eliminate high-value targets in stealth missions where precision and careful planning are key. Remain undetected as you take down enemies with pinpoint accuracy.

  • Speed and Survival: Test your reflexes in high-stakes timed missions. Engage multiple enemies, take them down quickly, and survive the onslaught when the bullets start flying.

Key Features

🎯 Hyper-Realistic VR Sniping
Feel the weight of the rifle, the tension of the trigger, and the satisfaction of landing the perfect shot. Realistic hand movements and natural shaking add a layer of challenge and authenticity to the experience.

🔧 Upgradeable Arsenal
Earn rewards through gameplay and unlock new weapons or upgrades in the in-game store. Customize your loadout to suit your playstyle and take on increasingly challenging missions.

🏆 Dynamic Scoring System
Compete for the highest score with a unique scoring system that rewards precision and speed:

  • Base points for successful eliminations.

  • Bonus points for headshots.

  • Extra points for quick mission completions.

🏙️ Immersive Environments
From abandoned towns to secluded outposts, each level offers a unique and atmospheric backdrop for your missions. The environments set the stage but the focus remains on the sniper’s perspective.

🎯 Practice Makes Perfect
Hone your skills in the interactive shooting range located in your base. Prepare for the mission ahead, sharpen your aim, and build the confidence to face any challenge.

Why MARKSMAN VR?

This isn’t just another shooter—MARKSMAN VR redefines the sniper genre in VR. Whether you’re sneaking through the shadows to take down your target or fighting against the clock to eliminate waves of enemies, every decision counts, and every shot matters.

Are you ready to embrace the thrill of being a marksman? It’s time to take aim.

short_description: Take on the role of an elite sniper in MARKSMAN VR, a thrilling VR shooter. Master stealth missions, race against time in intense battles, and test your precision with realistic aiming mechanics. Every shot matters in this immersive sniping experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 28 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 28 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 (with proprietary driver)
  • Storage: 28 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR

Marksman VR contains frequent depictions of stylized violence. The player eliminates enemy targets using sniper rifles, which results in visible blood splatter effects.

There are no depictions of gore, sexual content, drug or alcohol use, or any non-consensual acts.
